Let's map a practical next step.

I offer focused, confidential therapy for adults navigating anxiety, trauma, relationships and career transition. Sessions are intentional — we set clear aims and track progress together.

How I work — core commitments

Evidence-informed
Integrating CBT, somatic awareness, and relational frameworks rather than one-size-fits-all rules.
Practical focus
Short-term skills and long-term insight — tailored to your goals and timeline.
Warm directness
Clear observations, honest curiosity, and steady collaboration.
Confidential
Your privacy is upheld within professional and legal boundaries.

Common approaches I use

  • Short-term intensives (focused 8–12 week work)
  • Emotion-focused processing paired with behavior change
  • Trauma-informed stabilization and paced exposure
  • Relational and communication skills for couples/partners

Worried therapy won't fit you?

I understand hesitation — we can start with a 20-minute consult to see if the format and pace fit your needs. I work with adults of varied backgrounds; if I don’t think I’m the right match I’ll help you find alternatives.

Free guide: Starting therapy with intention

Download a short checklist that helps you clarify goals, choose session frequency, and track early wins. Ideal if you’re unsure where to begin.

Get the checklist

What to expect on first contact
  1. We’ll confirm insurance or self-pay options and intake logistics.
  2. We’ll discuss immediate priorities and whether an intensive or ongoing cadence fits best.
  3. Scheduling is flexible; telehealth and limited in-person options available.

Client notes

"I learned concrete steps to manage panic and rebuilt trust with my partner in months." — E., 34
"Clear, compassionate, and direct — I felt seen and progressed faster than expected." — R., 42

Privacy, scope & safety

All communications and records are kept confidential within legal and ethical limits. I will not disclose information without your consent except where required by law (e.g., imminent risk of harm, mandated reporting). Intake includes a brief discussion of limits to confidentiality and how we handle records.

Scope: I work with adults on anxiety, trauma, relationship issues, life transitions and burnout. If your needs fall outside my scope (e.g., severe active psychosis, substance withdrawal needing medical oversight) I will provide referrals.

If you are in crisis or at risk of harming yourself or others, please call emergency services immediately or use your local crisis line. I do not provide emergency services through email or the standard therapy portal.

Contact form

Or call {{PHONE}}

Insurance, fees & scheduling

I offer a range of appointment lengths and an intensive track for focused work. Fees and insurance participation vary; please contact me to confirm current rates and whether I can bill your plan or provide superbills for reimbursement.

See rate options
